# onetsolutions_hosting_wordpress_sites (Data Source)

Lists the WordPress sites installed on a web hosting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_web_hosting" "site" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

data "onetsolutions_hosting_wordpress_sites" "site" {
  hosting_id = data.onetsolutions_web_hosting.site.id
}

# The import IDs of the existing sites, to import them as onetsolutions_hosting_wordpress.
output "wordpress_import_ids" {
  value = [
    for site in data.onetsolutions_hosting_wordpress_sites.site.wordpress_sites :
    "${data.onetsolutions_web_hosting.site.id}/${site.id}"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hosting_id` (String) The UUID of the web hosting to read from.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `wordpress_sites` (Attributes List) The WordPress sites of the web hosting. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wordpress_sites))

<a id="nestedatt--wordpress_sites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wordpress_sites`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) The domain the site is installed on.
- `id` (String) The identifier of the site, to import it as an `onetsolutions_hosting_wordpress`.
- `path` (String) The path of the site under the domain, empty at its root.
- `title` (String) The title of the site.
- `version` (String) The WordPress version installed, empty until the web hosting reports it.
